title: XDC validators and candidates
description: Every masternode candidate with owner, stake and status, for XDC Mainnet or (in the Apothem file) the Apothem testnet. Candidates, owners and stake come from the validator contract (0x...88); MASTERNODE and SLASHED come from the current epoch switch block's header. No XDPoS_* calls.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema for this document.

version.description: Major version of this document's format. Fields are only added within a version.

generated_at.description: When this data was produced. ISO 8601, UTC.

update_interval_seconds.description: How often this document is regenerated.

stale_after_seconds.description: If generated_at is older than this, treat the data as stale (the feed may have stopped).

license.description: SPDX licence identifier for the data.

note.description: Optional remark about this copy of the data.

live_url.description: For hourly copies: the live URL this was copied from.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID: 50 for Mainnet, 51 for the Apothem testnet.

governance_note.description: Where the governance fields come from and how to read them.

history_note.description: How history_7d and history_30d are counted.

block_number.description: Block the data was read at.

epoch_switch_block.description: First block of that epoch, whose header lists the masternodes and slashed nodes.

candidates.description: Candidates listed: every address the validator contract lists with stake, plus the current masternodes and slashed nodes.

stake_wei.description: Total stake. Exact integer wei as a decimal string (1 XDC = 10^18 wei).

total_stake_wei.description: Total stake of listed candidates (owner stake plus votes). Exact integer wei as a decimal string (1 XDC = 10^18 wei).

masternode_owners.description: Distinct owners with at least one masternode.

owners_with_several_masternodes.description: Owners with more than one masternode.

governance_api.description: Governance API the governance fields came from, or null if it was unreachable.

masternodes_not_signing_recently.description: Masternodes with not_signing_recently = true. Null when the governance site was unreachable or its data looked out of date.

status_differs_from_governance.description: Candidates whose status here differs from the governance site (usually timing).

parameters.description: Public parameters of the validator contract.

min_candidate_stake_wei.description: Minimum stake to propose a masternode candidate. Exact integer wei as a decimal string (1 XDC = 10^18 wei).

min_voter_stake_wei.description: Minimum vote. Exact integer wei as a decimal string (1 XDC = 10^18 wei).

candidate_withdraw_delay_blocks.description: Blocks before a resigned owner can withdraw stake.

voter_withdraw_delay_blocks.description: Blocks before an unvoted amount can be withdrawn.

one_third.description: Fewest owners holding more than 1/3 of masternode seats.

one_half.description: Fewest owners holding more than 1/2 of masternode seats.

top_owners.description: Up to 25 owners with the most masternodes.

owner.description: Address in lowercase 0x hex. Replace 0x with xdc for the XDC-style form.

stake_wei.description: Stake across them. Exact integer wei as a decimal string (1 XDC = 10^18 wei).

candidate.description: Address in lowercase 0x hex. Replace 0x with xdc for the XDC-style form.

owner.description: Address in lowercase 0x hex. Replace 0x with xdc for the XDC-style form.

status.description: Current status, as in XDC Tycoon and the XDC governance site.

stake_wei.description: Total stake on this candidate (owner stake plus votes). Exact integer wei as a decimal string (1 XDC = 10^18 wei).

governance.description: From the XDC governance dApp API, when reachable. Not on-chain data.

name.description: Node name as registered on the governance site.

status.description: Status according to the governance site.

last_signed_block.description: Last block this node signed, as seen by the governance site's crawler.

blocks_since_last_signed.description: Blocks between that and the block this file was built at.

data_center.description: Hosting details the operator registered on the governance site, if the publisher includes them.

not_signing_recently.description: MASTERNODE only: true if it has not signed for more than 1,800 blocks (about an hour), per the governance site. Absent when that site was unreachable or its data looked out of date.

owner_stake_xdc.description: The owner's own stake in this candidate (the owner's voter cap).

votes_xdc.description: Stake voted by other addresses (stake_xdc minus owner_stake_xdc). Voters currently receive 0 % of rewards.

other_voters.description: Addresses other than the owner that have voted for this candidate. The contract keeps an address after it withdraws its vote, so some may hold no stake now; votes_xdc is the amount actually staked.

history_7d.description: Epochs recorded by this feed in the window (see history_note).

epochs_recorded.description: Epochs the feed recorded in the window (network-wide).

masternode_epochs.description: Of those, epochs this node was an eligible masternode.

slashed_epochs.description: Of those, epochs this node was slashed.

history_30d.description: Epochs recorded by this feed in the window (see history_note).

epochs_recorded.description: Epochs the feed recorded in the window (network-wide).

masternode_epochs.description: Of those, epochs this node was an eligible masternode.

slashed_epochs.description: Of those, epochs this node was slashed.
